These Shields.io responses were captured on 12 October 2026 for deterministic
browser checks. They are test fixtures, never published statistics. The website
loads live badges directly from Shields. Each response covers the requested
dark/light palette and flat-square/for-the-badge style.

The GitHub response currently says `repo not found`; keeping that response also
checks the layout with a longer upstream error. SourceForge and Docker metrics
are snapshots, not assertions about their current values.

Badge artwork comes from https://github.com/badges/shields (MIT / Apache-2.0).
